cover.note: Rhythm built from Melissa's SOPs dated 28 Sep 2026 (Motion Ads, iXperience ZA, iXperience USA). Country Hotels has no SOP yet. Items tagged confirm are open points in the SOPs.

rhythm.title: Start: Claude's brief, inbox and requests
rhythm.how: Read Claude's brief. Scan the Motion Ads mail forwarded to your Gmail and the iX inbox. Send the quick replies Claude drafted and clear any requests waiting in the queue. Anything bigger becomes a request for tomorrow.

rhythm.title: Processing: bank lines in Xero, all three companies
rhythm.how: Motion Ads: the feed doesn't link, so download the statement and import it, then code what you recognise. iX ZA: code new lines with the right VAT rate, unknowns to Suspense with a note, record the balance in the daily log. iX USA: the four feeds pull in automatically; code what you recognise. Leave anything unclear for the weekly session with Danny or the reviewer.

rhythm.title: Dext: forward new invoices and publish
rhythm.how: Forward any supplier invoice still sitting in your inbox to that company's Dext address (single or multiple). Then publish what Dext has ready in Motion Ads, iX ZA and iX USA after checking supplier, date, number, amount and VAT.

rhythm.title: Close: tick off and set tomorrow's musts
rhythm.how: Tick what's done. Anything open rolls to tomorrow; mark tomorrow's must dos. Stop at 09:00.

rhythm.title: Plan the week and review Claude's Mr H exceptions
rhythm.how: Open Week by company. Check aged payables and receivables for each company and note what's due. Clear the Mr H exceptions Claude found on Friday, or note who to ask.

rhythm.title: iX ZA: post last week's payments
rhythm.how: Post every payment made last week against its bill so aged payables is right for the week.

rhythm.title: iX USA: post last week's payments
rhythm.how: Danny loads the Mercury payments. Post each one against its bill in Xero so aged payables is right for the week.

rhythm.title: Motion Ads: chase missing slips
rhythm.how: List the card and EFT spend with no slip and send each person their list (Erin, John, Elan). Note who still owes what.

rhythm.title: iX USA: send Danny the missing receipts and unknown spend
rhythm.how: Claude lists card spend with no receipt, by cardholder, plus any lines you couldn't code this week. Send it to Danny; she chases the team and tells you what the spend was.

rhythm.title: iX USA: BD and referral payouts
rhythm.how: Calculate from the incentive trackers. Check each payout against a booked and paid sale. Get approval (approver still to confirm), pay and record in Xero.

rhythm.title: Motion Ads: update the payments sheet and send it to Mike
rhythm.how: Update the weekly payments sheet: each supplier invoice received (invoice date and number) and what is due by Friday. Email it to Mike to confirm. Tristan loads the payments and sends the Payment Summary.

rhythm.title: iX ZA: prepare Thursday's payment list
rhythm.how: List what is due, check each bill is approved and the bank details match, and send the list to the reviewer to approve.

rhythm.title: iX ZA: payment run and Mr H review
rhythm.how: The reviewer releases the approved payments. Post them in Xero, then review Claude's Mr H exceptions and clear Suspense or send it to the reviewer.

rhythm.title: Motion Ads: debtors
rhythm.how: Follow up any customer past due, starting with Kauai, Go Solar and Dog Stores. Claude drafts the emails.

rhythm.title: iX USA: HubSpot batch, revenue, payments and payouts
rhythm.how: Pick one day and stick to it; catching up later is painful. 1) Revenue: in HubSpot Invoices find the last number already in Xero, export the newer ones to Excel. Skip any still 'open' (the payment never went through). Raise each in Xero: new contact for the student, invoice date, HubSpot invoice number as reference, the programme line (e.g. Premed Cape Town deposit), channel tracking. 2) Payments: HubSpot Payments, status 'succeeded'. Export, keep date, amount and name, save as CSV, import as a statement into the 'HubSpot payments' bank account in Xero, and match each to its invoice. 3) Payouts: Payments, Payouts and reports. For each payout to Mercury, code the payout to the HubSpot control account and the HubSpot fee to the city expense account (Cape Town, Lisbon, Online, New York). The Mercury receipt also goes to the HubSpot control account, so the control account nets to zero. A 'duplicate' warning on import means it is already in.

rhythm.title: Motion Ads: post Tristan's Payment Summary
rhythm.how: Match the payments Tristan loaded to their bills in Xero and send remittances.

rhythm.title: Motion Ads: statements and this month's invoices
rhythm.how: On the 1st (or the following Monday if it falls on a weekend). Pull aged receivables. Customers who are up to date get only the new month's invoice. Anyone behind gets their statement plus the new invoice, with a note on what is past due. Start with the problem accounts: Dog Stores (backdated items), Go Solar (overdue since about July) and Kauai (unpaid; they need their order number on the invoice).

rhythm.title: iX ZA: EMP201 to reviewer, then submit and pay
rhythm.how: Internal deadline, one business day ahead of SARS. Payroll final, pull PAYE, UIF and SDL, agree to the control accounts, prepare on eFiling, send to the reviewer with the payroll report. Once approved, submit and pay with the PRN. Post the payment in Xero.

rhythm.title: Motion Ads: payroll changes to Justin and Ilan
rhythm.how: Gather leave, overtime, new starters and leavers for the month.

rhythm.title: Motion Ads: payment reminders (Claude drafts)
rhythm.how: Between the 20th and 22nd, send each customer a short reminder: invoice sent on the 1st, due on the 25th or 30th. Claude can draft these.

rhythm.title: Motion Ads: pay payroll
rhythm.how: Process salary payments.

rhythm.title: iX ZA: payroll and VAT201
rhythm.how: Confirm the period's invoices are captured and banks reconciled. Run the Xero VAT report, check output VAT, input VAT only on valid tax invoices, zero rated and exempt coding. Agree to the VAT control account. Send to the reviewer stating payment or refund and the amount. Submit once approved. SARS deadline is the last business day of the month.

rhythm.title: Motion Ads month end
rhythm.how: Post the PaySoft journal. Close VAT off every month: agree the VAT control account to the Xero VAT report. Royalty recon with Tristan. Update the campaign payments sheet (which campaigns have paid) and send it on so monday.com can be updated for John and Elan.

rhythm.title: iX USA month end with Mr H
rhythm.how: Four accounts reconciled to statements, Suspense cleared, aged payables and receivables reviewed, every Mercury card line has a receipt. HubSpot agrees to Xero by channel. BD, referral and Danny's offshore payments checked. Cost review. Run Mr H month end and hand over for management accounts.

rhythm.title: iX ZA month end with Mr H
rhythm.how: Run Mr H month end on iX ZA. Clear exceptions before management accounts.

rhythm.title: Country Hotels FM check in (outside your hour)
rhythm.how: No SOP yet. Cover the FM basics: cash position, payables due, payroll inputs, anything waiting on sign off.

rhythm.title: iX USA: check and send Claude's iX weekly report
rhythm.how: Claude drafts the iXperience weekly report before 08:00. Read it, fix anything off, and publish.

tone: Short, warm and direct. Three to six sentences unless the question needs more.
South African English spelling. Amounts as R12,500.00.
Always say what happens next and when: a day or a date, never 'soon'.
Never promise a payment date unless the bill is approved and in a payment run.
Do not use dashes as punctuation.
No attachments are mentioned unless they are actually attached.

rules.match: supplier or staff asks to change banking details
rules.do: Never change details from an email. Reply with the verification template and call the supplier on a number already on file.

rules.match: salary, payslip or someone else's pay
rules.do: Reply only to the employee concerned. Never copy others.

rules.match: any letter or email from SARS
rules.do: Put it on today's list as a must. Check eFiling before replying.

rules.match: request to pay today, outside the payment run
rules.do: Get written approval from the MD before loading. Treat urgency plus new bank details as likely fraud.

rules.match: bill, invoice, credit note or statement request
rules.do: Acknowledge now with the holding template. Do the work in tomorrow's 08:00 hour.

templates.name: Received, doing it tomorrow morning
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

Thanks, received. I'll process this first thing tomorrow morning and come back to you by 10:00.

[Signoff]

templates.name: When will I be paid
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

Thanks for following up. Invoice [number] for R[amount] is approved and scheduled for our [day] payment run on [date]. I'll send the proof of payment as soon as it is released.

[Signoff]

templates.name: Invoice not on our system
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

I can't find invoice [number] on our system. Please could you resend it with the purchase order number on it? Once I have it, it goes into the next payment run on [day].

[Signoff]

templates.name: Proof of payment
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

Please find attached proof of payment for R[amount] covering invoice [number]. It should reflect within one to two business days.

[Signoff]

templates.name: Overdue reminder to client
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

A friendly reminder that invoice [number] for R[amount] was due on [date]. Please could you let me know when we can expect payment? I've attached a statement for your records.

[Signoff]

templates.name: Bank detail change, verification
templates.when: Any request to change bank details
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

Thanks for letting us know. For security we don't update banking details from an email. Please send a signed letter on your letterhead together with a bank confirmation letter, and we will confirm the change by phone with our existing contact before any payment is made to the new account.

[Signoff]

templates.name: Payroll query
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

Thanks for your message. I'm checking this against the payroll and will come back to you by [day].

[Signoff]

templates.name: Missing receipt
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

These card transactions still have no receipt in Mercury:

[list]

Please upload a photo of each one in the Mercury app by Friday so I can close the week.

[Signoff]
